name: Salt Springs Campground (tent area)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Salt Springs Recreation Area, 13851 N Highway 19, Fort McCoy, FL 32134
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A big campground next to the Salt Springs swimming area: 52 tent-only primitive sites a short walk from parking, plus 94 electric RV sites at $70. About 21 miles and 33 minutes from Juniper Springs.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' This is a designated campground, so it stays legal for the whole trip. Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.

conditions.summary: Availability changes. Compare the saved individual site and night below, then confirm with the operator.

camp.carSleepingNote: The $38 sites are tent-only walk-in sites with separate parking; no rule found on sleeping in the car in the parking area.

Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.
camp.directions: Salt Springs is located 35 miles east of Ocala (I-75), 60 miles west of Daytona Beach (I-95) and 95 miles north of Orlando, Florida. From I-75 to Ocala: Drive east on State Route 40 for about 12 miles, then turn north on County Road 314 and proceed for 18 miles. Turn north on State Highway 19 and drive for about 0.5 mile to the recreation area entrance on the right. From I-95 east of Ormond Beach: Take SR 40 west about 40 miles to Highway 19. Turn north on Highway 19 and go about 16 miles to Salt Springs. Continue 0.5 miles to the recreation entrance on the right.
